metadata.title: Mid-Century Soul Pop Art Album Cover

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast 1960s soul aesthetic featuring a grayscale halftone portrait integrated with a speech bubble and bold primary color blocking.
triggerTerms: red and yellow geometric split background

recipe.visualDefinition: A central grayscale halftone portrait of a male figure, outlined in white, positioned against a vertically split background of vibrant red and yellow. A white speech bubble emerges from the subject's mouth to contain the primary typography, while secondary text is placed at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Portrait silhouette creates a hard boundary between red and yellow fields
Speech bubble tail originates precisely from the subject's mouth
White outline separates the grayscale subject from the saturated background
Typography is contained within the organic shape of the speech bubble
coreInvariants: Vertical split of primary red and yellow background colors
Grayscale halftone texture on the central human subject
White speech bubble as the primary container for display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale central portrait, slightly off-center to the left, cropped at the chest.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The high-contrast grayscale face of the subject.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's eyes, follows the speech bubble tail to the right-side text, then drops to the bottom metadata.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid blocks of red and yellow provide high-impact negative space around the central figure.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation background vs. desaturated grayscale subject.

composition.position: Inside speech bubble on the right

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different weights and colors for hierarchy.

avoid: Heavy bold weights for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric 'O' and clean monolinear strokes.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast grayscale halftone portrait of a man in a suit, outlined with a thick white border. Place him against a background split vertically: red on the left, yellow on the right. Include a large white organic speech bubble shape on the right side, with its tail pointing to the man's mouth. Leave the bubble and the bottom right area empty of text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Using a geometric sans-serif font like Futura Light, typeset the main title in black uppercase inside the speech bubble, left-aligned. Typeset the secondary credit in white uppercase at the bottom right, with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the portrait grayscale with a visible halftone pattern?
Is the background a clean split between red and yellow?
Does the speech bubble tail align with the subject's mouth?
Is the typography a clean, geometric sans-serif?

postGenerationChecks: Check for white outline consistency around the subject
Verify the speech bubble is pure white with no transparency
Ensure the red and yellow are vibrant and flat
Confirm text is perfectly legible against its background
Check that the halftone effect doesn't obscure facial features
recipe.reuseFormula: Grayscale Halftone Portrait + White Silhouette Stroke + [Color A]/[Color B] Split Background + Speech Bubble Typography Container
